contract: Master CSS 2.0 final semantic contract: named tokens, preserved native declarations, explicit queries and modes; fixed raw intent and whole-definition utility replacement
intentionalDifferences: Named-token selectors use hyphens and explicit token priority metadata.
RC value-dependent shorthand routing migrates to its explicit longhand; native aliases preserve native properties.
Master length x converts using saved RC settings; ordinary decimal spelling is preserved.
Explicit var() replaces implicit references inside raw values.
Groups emit independently ordered rules for each value source, selector, layer and importance.
Existing static and enum names retain semantic ordering; declaration ordering uses emitted properties and values.
Require languageVersion: 3 on manifests and hydration.
Replace global mode settings with explicit ordered mode branches; do not infer default values or color-scheme.
Scope base variables to Document and ShadowRoot using :root,:host.
Preserve breakpoint and container units; reject historical inferred condition syntax.
Utility kinds and value matchers are removed. Existing token-only fixtures keep their declarations and discard their unused RC kind field.

Directive redesign: Manifest 2 and language 4 replace managed modes, inline/static values and keyframes with scoped theme trees and native CSS. Custom media queries replace inferred breakpoint conditions. Theme output preserves authored declaration order and all scopes; current compiler fixtures use explicit selectors and singular @utility. Historical source snapshots remain unchanged.
